territorial_scope.description: Applies to eligible computer data centers in Washington State, which must be located in a rural county when the exemption application is received.

evidence.quote: Located in a rural county as defined in RCW 82.14.370 at the time an application for an exemption under this section is received

summary.short: Washington sales tax exemption for server equipment, eligible power infrastructure and installation labor at eligible computer data centers, subject to certificate, job and certification conditions; expires July 1, 2048.
summary.long: Exempts from the Washington sales tax imposed under RCW 82.08.020 sales to qualifying businesses and tenants of eligible server equipment and eligible power infrastructure installed at an eligible computer data center, plus related installation and construction labor. Eligible centers must be in a rural county, have at least 20,000 square feet housing working servers, and meet construction-start windows. Exemption certificates are issued by the Department of Revenue; no new certificates issue on or after July 1, 2036 (refurbished centers: July 1, 2026, capped at six per year). Holders must establish and maintain a net increase of family-wage jobs (35, or three per 20,000 square feet), with health insurance, within six years. Newly constructed centers must certify a recognized green building or energy standard within three years. Non-compliance cancels the certificate and makes exempted taxes due, with a 10 percent penalty for green-standard failure. Annual tax performance reports are required, and environmental practices are encouraged. The exemption expires July 1, 2048.

"Affiliated" means that one person has a direct or indirect ownership interest of at least 20 percent in another person.

"Building" means a fully enclosed structure with a weather resistant exterior wall envelope or concrete or masonry walls designed in accordance with the requirements for structures under chapter 19.27 RCW.
"Computer data center" means a facility comprised of one or more buildings

definitions.term: Electronic data storage and data management services

evidence.quote: "Electronic data storage and data management services" include, but are not limited to: Providing data storage and backup services, providing computer processing power, hosting enterprise software applications, and hosting websites.
"Eligible computer data center" means a computer data center:
"commencement of construction" means the date that a building permit is issued under the building code adopted under RCW 19.27.031 for construction of the computer data center.
"Eligible power infrastructure" means all fixtures and equipment owned by a qualifying business or qualifying tenant and necessary for the transformation, distribution, or management of electricity
"eligible server equipment" means the original server equipment installed within the space it leases
"Qualifying business" means a business entity that exists for the primary purpose of engaging in commercial activity for profit and that is the owner of an eligible computer data center.

"Qualifying tenant" means a business entity that exists for the primary purpose of engaging in commercial activity for profit and that leases space from a qualifying business within an eligible computer data center.
"Refurbished" or "refurbishment" means a substantial improvement to an eligible computer data center to update or modernize servers, server space, ventilation, or power infrastructure

"Server equipment" means the computer hardware located in an eligible computer data center and used exclusively to provide electronic data storage and data management services, including cloud services
family wage employment positions are new permanent employment positions requiring 40 hours of weekly work, or their equivalent, on a full-time basis
"New permanent employment position" means an employment position that did not exist or that had not previously been filled as of the date that the department issued an exemption certificate
Located in a rural county as defined in RCW 82.14.370 at the time an application for an exemption under this section is received
